newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 1st half exports rise to $11.697 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 1st half exports rise to $11.697 bln.

text.p: Earnings from Philippine exports grew to $11.697 billion in first six months of the year from $9.582 billion in the year-ago period, the National Statistics Office said on Tuesday.

The statistics office said exports in June were led by electronics and components which rose year-on-year by 12.6 percent to $839.9 million. Electronic exports comprised 39.5 percent of overseas sales in June.
Garments, the second biggest earner with a share of 10.2 percent of the total, recorded sales of $216 million in June, down 3.9 percent from last year.
The U.S. and Japan continued to be the country's biggest markets with a share of 34.6 and 18.6 percent respectively of the total merchandise exports for June.
